description: What your own API key or connected client called in the last 7 days, newest first: one row per tool or route, surface (`mcp`, `cli`, `api`) and UTC day, with `count`, the count per outcome, `firstAt` and `lastAt`. Never arguments or results. AnyForge tools read `allowed` or `refused` (scope, role, read-only key, rate limit or IP allowlist), not what the tool returned; connected tools (`kind: "connected_tool"`, `server/tool`) read `ok`, `error`, `approval_requested` or `refused`. Counts are written about once a minute. Without `credential` it reads the credential this connection uses; another member's credential is answered `credential_not_found`.

credential.description: Another API key or connected client of yours: the key's id, or `oauth_<familyId>`.

name: anyforge_list_my_tool_calls
title: List my tool calls
